Name: Harem Valley Extended Audio
Author: SagiriYanami
Description:
Harem Valley Extended Audio
AI Character Voices • Enhanced Cutscenes • Positional Audio
[b]Give the Valley a whole new sound![/b]
or Harem Valley / Valley Girls, designed to bring more life and atmosphere to the game's adult scenes.
This add-on introduces AI-generated character voices, enhanced cutscene audio, unique vocal variations, and integration with the original Harem Valley Positional Audio mod.
[b]Both cutscene audio and positional audio work together.[/b] You no longer have to choose between hearing characters during scripted events and hearing their activities around Pelican Town.
[line]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
1. Unique Voices for 10 Characters
Custom AI-generated voice recordings for:
[list]
[*]Abigail[/*]
[*]Caroline[/*]
[*]Emily[/*]
[*]Haley[/*]
[*]Jodi[/*]
[*]Leah[/*]
[*]Marnie[/*]
[*]Maru[/*]
[*]Penny[/*]
[*]Robin[/*]
[/list]Each character has a distinct vocal profile to make scenes feel more varied and recognizable.
2. Enhanced Cutscene Audio
Voice recordings have been integrated into more than 120 Harem Valley events.
The audio system is designed to follow the context of each scene, using different recordings for different activities.
Features include:
[list]
[*]Individual character voices during cutscenes.[/*]
[*]Separate audio variations for different types of adult scenes.[/*]
[*]Additional finishing sound effects.[/*]
[*]Continuous looping audio during extended animations.[/*]
[*]Preservation of original Harem Valley sound effects.[/*]
[/list]3. Context-Aware Multi-Character Scenes
Special attention has been given to scenes involving multiple characters.
Instead of playing every character's voice throughout the entire event, the audio changes to match the current stage.
Some scenes include specially mixed recordings featuring multiple characters simultaneously.
This includes selected events involving Emily and Maru, Caroline and Robin, Abigail and Leah, and other combinations.
4. Positional Audio Integration
The add-on also includes custom recordings for the original Harem Valley Positional Audio system.
Features:
[list]
[*]Individual character voices during scheduled NPC animations.[/*]
[*]Distance-based volume fading.[/*]
[*]Audio that becomes quieter as you move away.[/*]
[*]Support for muffled audio through certain doors.[/*]
[*]Separate audio settings for different characters.[/*]
[/list][b]Cutscene audio and world audio are both supported.[/b]
5. Original Sounds Preserved
Original Harem Valley sound effects remain intact.
The additional voice recordings are intended to complement the existing audio rather than replace the original effects.
6. Audio Processing
All custom audio recordings have been processed for use in Stardew Valley.
[list]
[*]OGG Vorbis format.[/*]
[*]44,100 Hz mono audio.[/*]
[*]Adjusted volume levels.[/*]
[*]Smoother transitions and loop preparation.[/*]
[*]Dedicated audio recordings for different situations.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
Install the following before using this add-on:
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Harem Valley / Valley Girls (original mod)[/*]
[*]Harem Valley Positional Audio by MasterRoshiHEHE[/*]
[*]Positional Audio framework by ichortower[/*]
[/list][b]Important:[/b] The original Harem Valley and Positional Audio mods are NOT included in this download.
This add-on was prepared for the original Harem Valley 3.6.0 content structure. Compatibility with other versions is not guaranteed.
[line]
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
Installation is simple if all required mods are already installed.
[list=1]
[*]Download and install all required mods.[/*]
[*]Close Stardew Valley completely.[/*]
[*]Download Harem Valley Extended Audio.[/*]
[*]Open your Stardew Valley installation folder.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded archive directly into the game folder.[/*]
[*]Merge the included
[code]Mods[/code]folder with your existing one.[/*]
[*]Allow existing audio files to be replaced when prompted.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]That's it![/b]
Both the new cutscene audio and custom positional audio should now be available.
Important Notes
[list]
[*]Do not delete the original Harem Valley Positional Audio mod.[/*]
[*]Do not install multiple versions of the Cutscene Audio Bridge.[/*]
[*]Remove older Harem Valley Extended audio patches before installation.[/*]
[*]Back up the original Positional Audio sound files if you want to restore them later.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Known Limitations[/heading]
[b]Background music:[/b] During voiced cutscenes, the additional audio currently uses the game's music channel. Background music may temporarily be replaced while the voice recording is playing.
[b]Compatibility:[/b] Some mod combinations, custom maps, or changes introduced by future Harem Valley updates may affect audio playback.
[b]Cutscene skipping:[/b] Audio behavior during skipped events may vary. Please report any recordings that continue playing after an event ends.
The release has undergone file and configuration checks, but not every event has been verified through in-game testing.
[line]
[heading]Credits[/heading]
[b]Trashracc1124[/b] — Original Harem Valley / Valley Girls.
[b]MasterRoshiHEHE[/b] — Original Harem Valley Positional Audio.
[b]ichortower[/b] — Positional Audio framework.
[b]Pathoschild[/b] — SMAPI and Content Patcher.
[b]Fish Audio[/b] — AI voice generation technology.
Special thanks to the original mod creators and the Stardew Valley modding community.
[line]
[heading]Bug Reports & Feedback[/heading]
If you encounter missing audio, broken cutscenes, incorrect character voices, or other issues, please report them in the Bugs section.
When reporting a problem, include:
[list]
[*]The character and event name.[/*]
[*]A description of what happened.[/*]
[*]Your Stardew Valley and SMAPI versions.[/*]
[*]Your SMAPI log.[/*]
[/list]Your feedback will help improve future releases!
[b]Enjoy a more immersive Harem Valley![/b]
